summary: Independent philosophical criticism adds ontology, agency, philosophical theology and anticolonial political thought. Arabic-language evidence includes both an original newspaper argument and an explicitly identified Rosenthal translation.
next: Broaden independent authors/platforms; the three Egid reviews share a critic and must not be treated as three independent critical communities.

sources.title: Agamben. Tutto è reale
sources.note: Solla reads Agamben’s threshold sections as argumentative devices and examines the claim that possibilities already possess reality without requiring actualization.
sources.limits: Reviewer explicitly restricts his interpretation to the new book’s opening threshold.

sources.title: Impossible freedom

sources.limits: One review; philosophical interpretation of neuroscience, not clinical guidance.
